tensions.body: No one owns how the planning board's swimlanes are labelled. Half the lanes are named after teams and half after customer outcomes, so every quarterly session opens with an argument about where a card belongs. We need a policy that settles lane naming once, and I'd like to bring a proposal to the next Governance Meeting.

When a release slips, it is unclear who decides whether to cut scope or move the date. Delivery Operations runs the train but does not own the scope call, and no role holds that decision explicitly. This has come up in three separate releases.
